description:
MCP server that lets AI agents work with the Excel and Word files already open on your desktop.

Office Live MCP connects AI agents (Claude, Cursor, Codex, ZCode and other MCP clients) to Microsoft Excel and Word
that are already open on this computer. Changes appear on screen immediately while you keep working next to the agent:
reading and writing ranges, formulas, formatting, tables, charts, pivot tables, Word documents, tables and comments,
with a journal and undo of the agent's changes. Requires desktop Excel and/or Word (Microsoft 365 / Office 2016+).
A silent install does not connect any agent; use Start > Office Live MCP > Connect to agents, or install
interactively (winget install -i) to choose agents in the wizard.
